stem:
Shaundra made this table in order to show the results of a science experiment.

Plant Growth

| Plant | Amount of Fertilizer Added to Soil (milliliters) | Change in Height of Plant (centimeters) |
|-------|--------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| A     | 4                                                | 0.5                                     |
| B     | 8                                                | 1.0                                     |
| C     | 1                                                | 0.15                                    |
| D     | 2                                                | 0.25                                    |

Which statement about the quantities in Shaundra’s experiment is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The amount of fertilizer added and the change in the height of the plants are both independent quantities.

options.label: B
options.text: The amount of fertilizer added and the change in the height of the plants are both dependent quantities.

options.label: C
options.text: The amount of fertilizer added is a dependent quantity, and the change in the height of the plant is an independent quantity.

options.label: D
options.text: The amount of fertilizer added is an independent quantity, and the change in the height of the plant is a dependent quantity.

visual_elements: Table showing plant growth with columns: Plant, Amount of Fertilizer Added to Soil (milliliters), Change in Height of Plant (centimeters)
